prototype_only_controls.description: When no host callbacks are supplied, interactions only update this component's local display. They do not prove data pagination.
A/numbers and C/buttons remain interactive prototype comparison variants; the handoff chooses B/folio for application lists.

acceptance_conditions: Use the folio presentation as the adopted list-footer reference; the footer sits directly above the bottom navigation without an extra separator.
The current/total number opens the full page grid upward, selecting a cell closes it, and clicking outside closes it without a dimmed background.
PW/SC footer heights are 52/68; primary cell heights are 40/48; picker cell heights are 46/56 design pixels.
The picker uses a 2-pixel top border, white background, #bbb inactive-cell borders, black current cells, and no animation or shadow.
Default picker maximum columns are 7 on PW and 10 on SC; rows are ceil(pages/maxColumns), then columns are ceil(pages/rows).
The page-number strip defaults to 7/9 slots on PW/SC; a positive slots or cols property overrides its corresponding default.
An exported open-picker state is a visual reference only; host callback dispatch and actual data paging require separately authorized functional verification.
